<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative Accountability:</strong> The Lok Sabha Speaker will inaugurate a conference in Thiruvananthapuram for chairpersons of Public Accounts Committees to strengthen parliamentary oversight across national and state legislatures.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE05eTRzUzB1WGxvTDFGc2pRcFdXck50SVV2TzdkRlRKVmRnaW9uUHBxZUx1SmstSldWZS1jdXF2SXlkeVE5U2NHVXBYc05XOGRrc1FKMVNldDlOSnhvcnlXRmFSUUszSkFfTHc5blE1aktHSTROOEVlUVpJN3Y?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political Discourse:</strong> TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee has attributed his party&#x27;s electoral setbacks in West Bengal to Supreme Court interventions rather than BJP political strategy.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Electoral Integrity:</strong> SP Chief Akhilesh Yadav has raised concerns regarding the Election Commission’s management of voter rolls and alleged deletions in Uttar Pradesh, intensifying scrutiny of electoral processes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Media Engagement:</strong> The Election Commission of India has launched its first All India Media Conference to improve public understanding and reporting of the national electoral process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
</ul>
